verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a built-in MCP server that exposes GlitchTip data to external AI assistants. That is the server role and does not show GlitchTip acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools. The axis is plausible for an error-tracking product with AI features, but nothing in the pack shows GlitchTip consuming external MCP servers.
